svg.title: IUS invitation - 8 June 1988 re-typeset study
svg.desc: Re-typeset from the supplied photograph of the invitation dated June 8, 1988. The visible invitation body is reproduced in outlined substitute type. The photographed spelling DAHLLOFF / Dahlloff is retained. The uncertain small header address and handwritten oval around RSVP are omitted. This is a reconstructed study, not an original scan or exact facsimile. Contact details are historical.

g.title: Interior University Society - vertical stationery mark
g.desc: The print reconstruction rotated minus 90 degrees to reproduce the orientation visible on the original letterhead. Transparent background; outlined lettering.
